method: Three class-weighted CatBoost classifiers over MolFormer, ChemBERTa, RDKit descriptors and MACCS features
eligibility: Positive mean scaffold OOF and valid AUPRC gains, at least two folds >= -0.002, objective > 1e-5
confirmation: Apply fixed selection to existing repeat scaffold split; report paired scaffold bootstrap uncertainty. Repeat split was previously used for diagnostics, not an independent test.
provenance: Documented during continuation of already running experiments; not a preregistered experiment
limitation: Historical OOF and official valid reused for many rounds; diagnostic gains cannot be converted to official points or guarantee an increase.
